poin.isi: Anthropic is building its own biology lab in the San Francisco area. The plan: Claude guides robots through drug experiments with minimal human involvement. Two supporting tools have already shipped, Claude Science and a hardware standard for controlling lab equipment.

Until now AI helped on screen: writing, analyzing, planning. This is agents stepping into physical work, running test steps, measuring, then repeating them in a real lab. Anthropic says the biggest opportunity sits in diseases that still have no treatment.
The same pattern is coming to everyday work: agents handle the repetitive technical steps, people keep the decisions. What to prepare now: a clear workflow and human checkpoints.

headline: AI AGENTS ENTER
THE REAL LAB
headline_caption: Claude guides robots through drug experiments in Anthropic's own lab.
subjudul: Anthropic is building its own biology lab: AI agents run the experiments, humans stay in charge.
